Welcome! Have you ever wondered what really shapes the way you think, make decisions, or even bounce back from tough times? Our brains are working behind the scenes every second—guiding not just how we remember things, but how creative and resilient we can be.
As we explore together, we'll dive into the fascinating world brought to life in Brain Rules: 12 Principles for Surviving and Thriving at Work, Home, and School, written by John Medina. This journey will help us uncover how the science of the mind—everything from our genetics and the environment we grow up in, to our day-to-day experiences—shapes who we are and how we succeed.
Imagine discovering twelve powerful, research-backed principles that could change the way you work, learn, and connect with others. What if you could boost your productivity, deepen your learning, and build stronger relationships, all by understanding how your brain really works? Along the way, you'll see how sleep, exercise, stress, and even the way you pay attention play a huge role in your day-to-day life. These aren’t just theories—they’re practical, doable strategies that bridge the gap between cutting-edge neuroscience and the real world. So, as we set out on this journey together, get ready to tap into your brain’s natural strengths. Whether you’re at work, relaxing at home, or learning in the classroom, you’ll find ideas that can help you adapt, grow, and truly thrive.
